name: Send SEC Form 4 insider trading alerts from AlphaAI to Discord

parameters.content:
## Send SEC Form 4 insider trading alerts from AlphaAI to Discord

### How it works

1. A Schedule Trigger runs the workflow every 30 minutes.
2. An HTTP Request node pulls the insider feed from the AlphaAI news API, covering SEC EDGAR Form 4 insider trades and institutional stake stories.
3. A Code node keeps material filings scored 6 or higher, skips filings posted in earlier runs and builds color coded embed cards showing Buy or Sell, the holding type and a link to the filing.
4. An HTTP Request node posts the cards to a Discord channel webhook as one message.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Create a free AlphaAI API key at alphai.io (Account, API keys).
- [ ] On the "Fetch Insider News" node, add a Bearer Auth credential and paste the key without the "Bearer " prefix.
- [ ] In Discord, create a channel webhook (Channel, Edit, Integrations, Webhooks) and paste its URL into the "Post Alerts to Discord" node.
- [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Customization

Adjust the schedule interval or the score threshold (MIN_SCORE) in the "Build Discord Alert Cards" node.

## Fetch insider filings

Runs every 30 minutes and pulls the AlphaAI insider feed of SEC Form 4 trades and institutional stake stories.

## Build alert cards

Keeps filings scored 6 or higher, dedupes across runs and builds Buy and Sell cards.

## Deliver to Discord

Posts all cards to a channel webhook in one message, with retries.
